desc: Validate the corrected implementation against supplied examples and exhaustive brute-force small arrays.
Fix deletion-state initialization and verify segment-tree operations with negative-infinity values.
Develop the simultaneous \(O(n\log n)\) DP approach with global add/chmax and point restoration.
Handle no deletion, all-negative arrays, all-equal arrays, zero values, and the non-empty-array restriction.
Establish that each DP state represents the best valid subarray sum after deleting one fixed value.
Provide the final implementation using the required starter method and concise comments.
